### CVE-2021-22539 — Code execution in VSCode-bazel via malicious Bazel config files
- Assigner: Google | Published: 2021-04-16 | Updated: 2024-09-17 | Max CVSS: 8.2
- CWE: CWE-73 CWE-73 External Control of File Name or Path
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.2 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`

An attacker can place a crafted JSON config file into the project folder pointing to a custom executable. VScode-bazel allows the workspace path to lint *.bzl files to be set via this config file. As such the attacker is able to execute any executable on the system through vscode-bazel. We recommend upgrading to version 0.4.1 or above.

**solutions:** Upgrade vscode-bazel to version 0.4.1 or above

Affected:
- Google LLC / VSCode-Bazel: affected unspecified <=0.4.0 (custom)

Credits: RyotaK

References:
- https://github.com/bazelbuild/vscode-bazel/security/advisories/GHSA-2rcw-j8x4-hgcv [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://github.com/bazelbuild/vscode-bazel-ghsa-2rcw-j8x4-hgcv/pull/1 [x_refsource_MISC]

### CVE-2021-22543 — Improper memory handling in Linux KVM
- Assigner: Google | Published: 2021-05-26 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: 8.7
- CWE: CWE-119 CWE-119 Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
- CVSS 4.0 (cna): 8.7 HIGH `CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:H/AT:N/PR:L/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:L/SC:H/SI:H/SA:L`

An issue was discovered in Linux: KVM through Improper handling of VM_IO|VM_PFNMAP vmas in KVM can bypass RO checks and can lead to pages being freed while still accessible by the VMM and guest. This allows users with the ability to start and control a VM to read/write random pages of memory and can result in local privilege escalation.

Affected:
- Linux Kernel / Linux Kernel: affected add6a0cd1c5ba51b201e1361b05a5df817083618 <f8be156be163a052a067306417cd0ff679068c97 (git)

Credits: David Stevens; Kevin Hamacher; Jann Horn

References:

- http://www.openwall.com/lists/oss-security/2021/06/26/1 [mailing-list,x_refsource_MLIST]

### CVE-2021-22545 — Use-after-free in BinDiff
- Assigner: Google | Published: 2021-06-29 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-416 CWE-416 Use After Free
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:L/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`

An attacker can craft a specific IdaPro *.i64 file that will cause the BinDiff plugin to load an invalid memory offset. This can allow the attacker to control the instruction pointer and execute arbitrary code. It is recommended to upgrade BinDiff 7

Affected:
- Google LLC / Bindiff: affected unspecified <7.0 (custom)

Credits: Mickey Jin of Trend Micro Mobile Security Research Team

References:
- https://www.zynamics.com/bindiff/manual/index.html#nyyyy7 [x_refsource_MISC]

### CVE-2021-22568 — Dart - Publishing to third-party package repositories may expose pub.dev credentials
- Assigner: Google | Published: 2021-12-09 | Updated: 2024-08-03 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: CWE-255 CWE-255 Credentials Management
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:H/A:L`

When using the dart pub publish command to publish a package to a third-party package server, the request would be authenticated with an oauth2 access_token that is valid for publishing on pub.dev. Using these obtained credentials, an attacker can impersonate the user on pub.dev. We recommend upgrading past https://github.com/dart-lang/sdk/commit/d787e78d21e12ec1ef712d229940b1172aafcdf8 or beyond version 2.15.0

Affected:
- Google LLC / Dart SDK: affected unspecified <2.15.0 (custom)

References:
- https://github.com/dart-lang/sdk/commit/d787e78d21e12ec1ef712d229940b1172aafcdf8 [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://github.com/dart-lang/sdk/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://github.com/dart-lang/sdk/security/advisories/GHSA-r32f-vhjp-qhj7 [x_refsource_MISC]

### CVE-2021-22569 — Denial of Service of protobuf-java parsing procedure
- Assigner: Google | Published: 2022-01-07 | Updated: 2025-04-21 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-696 CWE-696 Incorrect Behavior Order
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

An issue in protobuf-java allowed the interleaving of com.google.protobuf.UnknownFieldSet fields in such a way that would be processed out of order. A small malicious payload can occupy the parser for several minutes by creating large numbers of short-lived objects that cause frequent, repeated pauses. We recommend upgrading libraries beyond the vulnerable versions.

Affected:
- Google LLC / protobuf-java: affected unspecified <3.16.1 (custom); affected unspecified <3.18.2 (custom); affected unspecified <3.19.2 (custom)
- Google LLC / protobuf-kotlin: affected unspecified <3.18.2 (custom); affected unspecified <3.19.2 (custom)
- Google LLC / google-protobuf [JRuby Gem]: affected unspecified <3.19.2 (custom)

Credits: OSS-Fuzz - https://github.com/google/oss-fuzz

References:
- https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=39330
- https://cloud.google.com/support/bulletins#gcp-2022-001

The vulnerability is that IDToken verifier does not verify if token is properly signed. Signature verification makes sure that the token's payload comes from valid provider, not from someone else. An attacker can provide a compromised token with custom payload. The token will pass the validation on the client side. We recommend upgrading to version 1.33.3 or above

Affected:
- Google LLC / Google-oauth-java-client: affected unspecified <1.33.2 (custom)

References:
- https://github.com/googleapis/google-oauth-java-client/pull/872 [x_refsource_MISC]
